text:
rachel: Hey team — handing off the partner labs simulation kit for the new cloud SI. Goal: a lightweight Terraform + demo workload that partners can run in <2 hours to validate networking, AMP/Graviton compat, and autoscaling behavior. Upload is in the artifacts bucket :package:.
kevin: Awesome, thanks. Does the kit include region-specific variables or do partners set those themselves?
marta: It has a regions.tfvars.example but we wanted to keep defaults to us-west1/us-east1. Partners should swap in their own AZs if needed.
rachel: Correct. The README calls out the variables file. Quick snippet we included:
```
variable "region" {
  type = string
  default = "us-west1"
}
```
jon: For the demo workload, what's the expected VM/GPU profile? We need a simple mapping table for the sales/engineers.
alex: We used a small profile in the kit: 1x g4dn.xlarge (for CPU path) and a 1x a10g for the full perf path. Also included a quantized variant to show cost delta.
kevin: Can we add a tiny perf benchmark script? Something partners can run to collect p95 latency and token/sec.
rachel: Yep — included run_bench.sh that hits the local endpoint and posts results to /results. Example output in artifacts/bench-sample.json.
marta: Two ask items from solutions: 1) add a short troubleshooting block for common CNI issues, 2) call out IAM service account requirements in a single table.
rachel: Adding those now. Will push a patch in ~30m. @deploy-bot — the current artifact tag is partner-labs-v0.9.
deploy-bot: artifact partner-labs-v0.9 uploaded to s3://redwood-partner-artifacts/2178881110/partner-labs-v0.9.tar.gz
jon: Sweet. After your patch can we run a dry onboarding with CloudEng and one SI next week? Aim to collect feedback within 48 hours.
alex: I can run the dry onboard Wed morning and take notes.
kevin: I'll prepare a short checklist for preflight infra (VPC size, subnet ranges, EKS version, KMS keys). Will post later today.
rachel: Perfect. Follow-ups:
- rachel: add troubleshooting + IAM table (in progress)
- kevin: preflight checklist (ETA today)
- alex: dry onboarding (Wed AM)
- marta: sample workload TTL and cleanup doc (you on this?)
marta: Yup, will add cleanup hooks and a cronjob example in cleanup.md.
rachel: Great — once we merge I'll bump tag to partner-labs-v1.0 and send the partner-facing email template.
jon: Nice, let's keep the demo under a 2-hour setup target.
alex: noted. I'll time the run and share a short recording.
kevin: If anyone hits CNI errors ping me directly, those are common with smaller /16 allocations.
rachel: Thanks all. I'll post the PR link when ready. :rocket:
